adeb W.P.A. 1169 of 2016 Baijnath Mahato Vs. The State of West Bengal & Ors.
Mr. Sukumar Ghosh Ms. Moumita Ghosh ....for the petitioner Mr. Ayan Banerjee Ms. Debasree
Dhamali

...for the Bally Municipality Petitioner is an employee of Bally Municipality who was placed under suspension vide order dated 11th July, 2013 with effect from 23rd May, 2013 since he was found to have been implicated in a criminal case being Bally P.S. Case No. 316/13 dated 22nd May,
2013 under Sections 498A/325 I.P.C.

Subsequently the Chairman of Bally Municipality by issuing order dated 20th/21st November, 2013 revoked the order of suspension with effect from 22nd November, 2013 and petitioner was allowed to resume duty with effect from 22nd November, 2013.
Petitioner has filed one supplementary affidavit enclosing order dated 29th February, 2020 passed by the Criminal Court whereby petitioner has been acquitted.

On placing reliance upon the said order dated 29th February, 2020 it has been submitted by the learned advocate representing the petitioner that in view of order of acquittal passed in favour of the petitioner he is entitled to receive service benefits which could not be released in his favour due to issuance of suspension order dated 11th July, 2013.

Today, the learned advocate representing Bally Municipality on instruction submits that in view of order of acquittal passed by the Criminal Court dated 29th February, 2020 arrear salary which is remaining outstanding can be released in favour of the petitioner adjusting subsistence allowance which was paid to the petitioner during suspension.

Having heard the learned advocates representing the parties and on perusal of the materials available on record this Court directs the concerned authority of Bally Municipality to release arrear salary to the petitioner for the period from 23rd May, 2013 till 21st November, 2013 adjusting subsistence allowance within 4 (four) weeks from the date of communication of this order.

However, it has been submitted on behalf of the Municipality that petitioner is receiving service benefits in terms of ROPA 2009 Rules, at present there is no necessity to pass any order for giving effect to the relevant provisions under ROPA 2009 Rules in connection with service of the petitioner With the aforesaid directions, the writ petition stands disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
